en.headline: 10 own commits plus 20 automated commits by github-actions[bot]
en.summary: On 2026-10-18, sogeisetsu landed **10 own commits** across three repositories, plus **20 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` there were 5 commits: removing references to deleted documentation and making the spec self-contained, moving plans into the repo's `.openchamber/plans` directory, adding a Steps checklist with corrected cross-references, normalizing line endings to LF, and a revised `skill_management` spec plus a feasibility evaluation. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` there were 4 commits fixing duplicate resident-issue creation with a visible delay and self-healing, restricting the "sum expression" invariant in the auto-commit verifier to avoid full-text scanning, degrading the notifier page to "未取到 issue 链接" on failure, and overhauling AI failure visibility, model annotation, and the 30-day summary. The single commit in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` added an `opencode-provider` knowledge category covering the catalog's three-tier sources, credential ownership, endpoints, and OpenChamber governance. The issues total of 1 reflects a comment on `openchamber/openchamber` issue `#4939` ("[Bug] Text selected inside an openchamber_render page never opens the comment menu", 2 comments), where sogeisetsu replied; 3 other issues were closed by btriapitsyn in state changes (`#4896`, `#4920`, `#4601`).

zh.headline: 10 次本人提交，另有 20 次由 github-actions[bot] 自动提交；评论 1 个 issue 并发起 1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-18 当天，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库共完成 **10 次本人提交**，此外 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 还有 **20 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交**。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 有 5 次提交：删除已移除文档的引用并让规范自含，把计划改存到仓库的 `.openchamber/plans` 目录，补充 Steps 清单并修正交叉引用，统一换行符为 LF，以及 `skill_management` 规范修订版加可行性评测。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 4 次提交：修复常住 issue 重复创建（可见延迟加自愈），把自动提交校验中「相加表述」不变式改为不再扫全文，让 notifier 失败时页面退化为「未取到 issue 链接」，以及 AI 失败可见性、模型标注与 30 天总结改版。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 1 次提交新增了 `opencode-provider` 知识类别，涵盖 catalog 三层来源、凭据归属、端点与 OpenChamber 管辖。issue 总数 1 指的是在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 `#4939`（"[Bug] Text selected inside an openchamber_render page never opens the comment menu"，2 条评论）上评论；另有 3 个 issue 由 btriapitsyn 在状态变更中关闭（`#4896`、`#4920`、`#4601`）。收到 2 条 issue 回复：btriapitsyn 在 `#4601` 说明思考等级已在 `7d037b07d` 修复，yulia-ivashko 在 `#4899` 表示无法复现 CSS 像素导出问题。sogeisetsu 还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起了讨论 `#5114`（"[Idea] Split the rendered-page selection-menu fix: frame→host selection bridge first (#4939)"）。当天没有 pull request、评审、release 或 star 记录。仅检查了每个分区的前 25 条，部分状态变更可能未收录；events、replies、stateChanges 的上限均未触发。
